workflow.title: Monday digest of done tasks
workflow.goal: Email liz@beaconcontent.co a short list of tracker tasks marked done, for the Monday morning run. Open and blocked tasks are excluded. The tracker has no completion date, so every task currently marked done is listed.

assumptions: The tracker sheet has no completion date, so the digest lists every task currently marked done rather than only those closed last week.
Run this flow each Monday; the workflow itself does not create a schedule.
Recipient is liz@beaconcontent.co as given by the requester.
Open and blocked tasks are excluded as requested.
risks: Older done tasks may appear in the digest because completion dates are not tracked.
The outbox send is an outside action and asks a person before dispatch when run live.
successCriteria: Only tracker rows with status done are included in the email.
The email is delivered to liz@beaconcontent.co.
The delivered message passes the independent outbox check.

nodes.description: Keep only tracker rows whose status is done.
Keep title, status and owner of each done row.
Count and list the tasks marked done.
Write the email body from the done list.
Email the done-task digest to liz@beaconcontent.co.
Independently re-read the delivered message and compare its hash.

metadata.rationale: Tracker rows carry status and owner only, so the digest filters on status done before counting and emails the list. Completion dates are not tracked, so the 'last week' window cannot be applied exactly.
